test_check_email_requirements: test the check_email_requirements function to verify email environment variables are set
build_email_adapter: build an EmailAdapter instance from PlatformConfig to connect to an IMAP/SMTP email server
test_email_adapter_connect: test the EmailAdapter connect method to verify IMAP and SMTP connections succeed
create_send_email: create an email reply by calling EmailAdapter.send with a chat_id and message body
create_send_document: create an email with a file attachment by calling EmailAdapter.send_document with a file path
